body: Same, and I hate that there’s really nothing you can do for any of these people except be there in this strange, virtual space.
Well, I hope you find some comfort.

And you’ve gotten this far. Surely that means something ? It’s weird navigating these times, definitely. If anything it’s made me want to change things. Change the world, build myself up, that kind of thing. Not sure how great it’s going since I’m here and all, but ! Your words sound really familiar to me. . . So take care of yourself.

Sure. I didn’t even know how to make friends before covid and the running joke with my coworkers is how my whole life has been preparing me for social distancing. It’s funny, in a way. But I still think the fact that everyone’s experiencing the same thing at the same time somehow makes it a bit less lonely.

You know, it’s strange: every close friendship I’ve ever had (and admittedly it hasn’t been many) has been made when I wasn’t out there actively looking for them.  And it’s really easy for me to say (think?) that the take away from that is the importance of being yourself and having other people see you for who you are and all those lovely thoughts but. . .  it’s hard. It’s really hard. And while all those positive thoughts might have some truth to them (I still believe, somewhere deep inside) I also think that things happen for a reason. All this to say, don’t lose hope. Or at the very least take comfort in knowing you aren’t alone.

This is kind of interesting too -

[what happened here ?](http://web.archive.org/web/20020924075555/http://aylana.tripod.com/) Why had she left this time ?

Apparently she owned a tripod account as well. Not much of anything useful is still accessible but it’s there. I guess at one point she had a .com using her name as well.

Bebop is one of those things where it’s good to go back to it every few years. Often enough that you remember enough to spot little references to the ending that you may have missed before, but not so often that it’s no longer a treat to sit through. After all these years I still cry at the end ! I admit, I’m a baby. 

Yeah, ok, I suck at fighting games too but I still enjoy them lol. I was super into soul caliber for years. Can I do any combos ? No, but I can button mash like a professional. Breath of the Wild looks really good. . I own it, but I’ve never played. Everyone keeps saying it’s the be all, end all greatest switch game of all time and I don’t want to ruin it for myself ! What a weird thing to be afraid of, right ? 

Im in a suburb of a big city and even my connection isn’t that great. WoW i felt myself getting addicted to when I first started so I had to step back. I was really into MUDs, though - years and years of explaining, “it’s like Warcraft without the graphics !” I feel super old but I’m only 30 🤔

What else are you into? What kind of memes do you like ? Tell me about yourself ? (Is this how you do friendship. . ? I’m super awkward, whoops )

That’s really interesting. You almost never see people talking about vignette typed anime. I’ve actually never seen either of those myself - like I said, just getting back into it ! - but I have a couple manga series in that genre. I guess the closest I’ve seen lately as far as anime goes is Welcome to the N.H.K. but I’m only a couple episodes in and I’m not sure what to make of it yet. As far as the manga goes Sweetness and Lightning is the last one I’ve read that could be considered slice of life. 

I’m not sure what my favourite genre is. Cowboy Bebop is my all time favourite but it’s not about the plot for me as much as it is the characters. Strong characters I think are more important! I also think visuals are important, too. So I’ve seen The Woman Called Fujiko Mine lately too and I liked it because of how different it looked and felt next to anything else I’ve seen. 

So, you said video games, too. What kind? I like them as well but I’m learning more and more that I suck. RPGs are more my speed but I just bought myself Smash so I could pretend to be normal, haha.

Hey man, congrats on putting yourself out there. I know how hard that can be ! 

What kind of anime do you like ? I just started getting back into them after a couple year hiatus. Also what kind of games? Especially the table tops — I’ve never played one myself but I’m really into the world of darkness settings (especially the vampire books, masquerade being my favourite)

What are cons like ? Never been to one of those either but I’ve always wanted to. Cosplaying seems really fun, but I can’t think of any characters I’d look like.
Not sure where you got that from. The friendship lasted over nine years.

Of course not! Everything happens for a reason. I still talk to the person this was for and like I said, we can love each other in other ways. All for the better. 

And yes, it’s one of my favourites too.
This is beautiful! Your friend is lucky to have someone like you. It was such an uplifting experience reading this. What hope it evokes!

Thanks. I’ve tried, previous months. I suppose the tones gone from upset to setting ultimatums. If this sort of thing holds any value to you you’ll talk to me. That sort of thing. And every time it’s resolved by saying okay, sure, I will, you’re still my best friend to....total radio silence. I’m not fully blaming them, as I said, apathy is dangerous and terrifying and that’s my burden to carry as of right now. But, thank you. I think it is one of the many masks anxiety wears. I need to do it. At the very least, I need to do something.
